title: Loyalty discounts at checkout
description:
Implements the loyalty programme from PRICING-212:

- tier rates: silver 5%, gold 10%, platinum 15%
- first order: at least 10% for everyone
- members for 5+ years get an extra 2%
- coupon + loyalty are capped at 30% of the subtotal (loyalty is reduced first)

`computeTotals` now takes the customer's loyalty profile. Manually checked the checkout page with a gold and a first-order account.
